name: Tom Emmer
page_title: Tom Emmer's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (MN) - District 6

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As a father of seven who values the sanctity of life, I am proud to have received an A+ rating from @sbaprolife on my pro-life scorecard. I will always protect the lives of the unborn."
"I am inspired by everyone who walked to defend the unborn this week at marches around the country. From St. Paul to Washington, D.C. - I stand with all of you. #ProLife"
Rated 100% by the National Right to Life Committee
Voted against HR 8297: "Ensuring Access to Abortion Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Proud recipient of the 2018 Medicare Advantage Champion award from @protectmyMA! I will keep fighting to protect Medicare Advantage for the millions of seniors and individuals with disabilities who depend on it."
"We are committed to a government that’s accountable. We will rein in government abuse of power and corruption, provide real transparency, and save and strengthen Social Security and Medicare."
Rated 0% by the National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare
Rated 7% by the Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Democrats’ reckless spending and massive tax hikes are destroying our economy."

"Today the House passed and I supported Tax Reform 2.0 to make tax cuts permanent for individuals and families, expand retirement-savings incentives, and tax breaks for startup businesses. #TaxCutsWork"
Voted in favor of HR 1: "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"
Voted in favor of HR 6760: "Protecting Family and Small Business Tax Cuts Act of 2018"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 4521: "America COMPETES Act of 2022"

"I think it’s very obvious that one of the main drivers of inflation has been runaway government spending over the past year, which has pumped trillions of new dollars into the U.S. economy – despite our $30T debt."
"Out-of-control government spending and anti-American energy policies that Democrats are pushing are why inflation continues to hit working families hard."
Voted against HR 7688: "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "American taxpayers, including people who didn’t go to college, should NOT be forced to subsidize billions of dollars in student loans."
Voted against HR 2547: "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"

"Biden’s student loan scam would’ve bailed out the wealthy while forcing taxpayers – including those who didn’t go to college – to foot the bill. I’m glad SCOTUS set the record straight: Biden does NOT have the Constitutional authority to unilaterally "erase" student loan debt."

"Debt cannot be cancelled; it can only be transferred. President Biden’s socialist proposal to "cancel" student loan debt will fuel inflation and do nothing to fix our broken higher education system."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "Soon, the Senate will vote on @HouseDemocrats’ cynical, partisan power grab #HR1. This bill will seize power from the states, legalize ballot harvesting & make basic election security ILLEGAL. I voted against this bill in the House & hope my Senate colleagues will do the same."
Voted against HR 4: "John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2021"
Voted against HR 5746: "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "TikTok is a CCP spy app. Plain and simple. House Republicans just passed a nonpartisan bill protecting Americans' data by sending a clear message: TikTok must sever ties with the CCP or lose its access to American users."

"TikTok’s lawsuit confirms what we already knew: They’re nothing but a CCP spy app, plain and simple. Congress refused to stand idly by as China exploits the data of 170 million American users, and we trust the courts will see this as the national security threat that it is."
